13.t: Working with data: mass in a reaction
q: By how much did the open flask’s mass fall in 5 minutes?
Explain why the mass of the flask with the balloon did not change.
The gas was trapped in the balloon, so no mass left the system: mass is conserved.
Explain why chemical equations must be balanced.
Atoms are not made or destroyed in a reaction, only rearranged; a balanced equation has the same number of each atom on both sides, so mass is conserved.
